result: The batch title is the batch name alone; one primary press outside dialogs follows the current step; Evidence by key starts collapsed with its declared-key count; verify-page titles use ul-title.
decisions: primaryPress(selected, items) in needs-model.ts: 'layout' while the selected item needs a layout answer or its recipe is proposed, else 'table' while it is a kept table, else 'record'. BatchPage computes it once and passes a boolean to LayoutQuestion, BatchTableSection and IntakeRunPanel; the others render 'secondary' when the flag is false.
Read as a table is primary only while the table is unread (its form shows only then); after the read nothing on the page is primary until another item is selected. Stated, not hidden.
AnswerForm defaults primary=true because StreamedLayoutAnswer (not owned) renders it and only does so while the layout is the step; LayoutAnswer passes the flag explicitly.
Confirm keeps its press primary while a cards list is open (an open form replacing the panel).

Evidence by key: the h2 holds a ghost toggle (aria-expanded, caret) reading 'Evidence by key (n)', n = declared key profiles from the batch evidence read (no number while unknown). It opens on the toggle, on a Declare request, while a declaration form is open, and when focus lands on the section or its heading (focusSection evidence-by-key). While closed, the heading span carries id confirm-evidence so a Needs-you press lands there, opens the section, then moves focus to the real confirmation heading. Collapsing cancels an open declaration form.
Verify pages: h1 titles (record name, Property card verification, both not-found titles) moved from ul-heading to ul-title. UlpinCode already renders at 13px mono (id-code metrics); unchanged.
No name in the owned files used ul-mono or ul-id; the remaining mono spans are hashes, a parcel ULPIN, reason codes and target locators, which stay mono.

inputs.captured: docs/evidence/gf1/lq1a/controls-second.json (buildings-original.geojson, its manual-geojson/1 profile) and docs/evidence/gf1/e3b/targets.json (one reviewed package)
inputs.test_only: register.csv table item and one evidence key profile built in the test; no record is claimed

checks.command: pnpm --filter @ulpin/studio exec vitest run src/features/intake src/features/verify

tests: primary-press.test.tsx: one primary (outside the step strip) with a layout to answer, a table to read and packages to record, the record press present in all three; the h1 is the batch name; the rule's four branches; Evidence by key closed with (1), open after focusSection plus the focus event, closed again on its toggle. empty-state.test.tsx: closed by default. CardVerificationPage.test.tsx: h1 has ul-title.
not_verified: Browser focus behaviour (fake document sends no focus events; the test sends it) and the visual look of the toggle inside the heading; no runtime started.
outside_own: StepStrip.tsx renders the current step with variant primary, so the page shows two primary buttons; the new test excludes the Batch steps nav. V4 asks for an underline on the current step (S7.17 scope).
PageImageQuestion.tsx marks the chosen label with variant primary; untouched.
